facts.text: "Right, Ed, peanuts, crisps and a round of pints. If anyone looks a bit grey, we'll sort it after dinner."
facts.why: Shaun never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Shaun, so it reads as a film line, but his actual plan line is about Mum's, Liz and the Winchester.
facts.fix: Go to Mum's, kill Phil, grab Liz, go to the Winchester, have a nice cold pint, and wait for all of this to blow over.

fix_note.text: Have a nice cold pint, and wait for all of this to blow over.

facts.text: Serve the drinks when Shaun and Liz argue at the Winchester.
facts.why: This is the cue on the phone menu. The data cue says they make it to the Winchester, which is right. The plot summaries only show arguments at the Winchester between Shaun and Ed (over Ed's phone) and Shaun and David. Liz and Shaun's breakup happens before the outbreak. Nothing I read shows a Shaun and Liz argument in the pub. The phone and data cues should match.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when they make it to the Winchester.

facts.text: 1. Cricket bat by the door  2. Crisps and peanuts, Ed
facts.why: The prop is titled Shaun's Plan but the film's plan is to get Mum and Liz, then wait it out at the Winchester with a pint. Nobody plans around crisps and peanuts.
facts.fix: 1. Mum's, then Liz  2. The Winchester, one cold pint

facts.why: The note says it is the morning after with Ed. The page I read names the Cornetto as Ed's hangover cure and does not mention a fry up, so I could not confirm a fry up scene.
facts.fix: Shaun's morning shop run, a Coke and a Cornetto

vibe.verdict: A believable Winchester pub board, but it leans on pub clichés and skips the film's most quoted moments.
missing: You've got red on you (Ed and Shaun in the back garden)
Strawberry Cornetto and a Coke from the corner shop (Shaun's dazed morning walk)
Throwing the vinyl records, Diamond Life included (Shaun and Ed in the garden)
Don't Stop Me Now on the jukebox while they beat Phil (Winchester)
The fruit machine that draws the zombies in (Ed in the Winchester)
Philip's Jaguar and the bitten stepdad in the back seat
ideas: Swap 'Salt and vinegar potato chips' for 'Coke and a Cornetto from the corner shop', since it doubles up on Corner shop crisps now.
Swap the made up Shaun note for his real plan line about Mum's, Liz and the Winchester.
Swap 'Pint of English ale' for 'Warm flat pint, last one in the Winchester', since it doubles up on Pint at the Winchester.
Add a printed gag line on the board: 'You've got red on you' next to the strawberry ripple cones.
